rules.rule: Use approved canonical URL, visible title and accurate description; no placeholder fields.

rules.schema: Organization; WebSite; LocalBusiness only if Nepal details are verified
rules.rule: No fake overseas offices, sameAs profiles or aggregate ratings.

rules.schema: Service + BreadcrumbList + visible FAQPage only if FAQs are real
rules.rule: Only after capability gate; provider must be the real approved entity.

rules.schema: SoftwareApplication/Product + BreadcrumbList + Offer only if current pricing exists
rules.rule: Only after product gate; no invented reviews, ratings, pricing or availability.
Named real author and reviewer; publish date and modified date accurate; content visible.

rules.schema: FAQPage only when visible and genuinely useful
rules.rule: Do not generate FAQ blocks solely for search markup.
Legal text reviewed and version-dated by qualified counsel.

provenance.label: [VERIFIED-TOOL]
provenance.meaning: Direct Hiver verification, current Hiver crawl or uploaded route/SEO workbook field.

provenance.label: [REFERENCE-ONLY]
provenance.meaning: Evidence from supplied Nexly reference crawl; not Hiver ownership or Hiver ranking data.

provenance.label: [DATA REQUIRED]
provenance.meaning: Must be supplied by Hiver or qualified counsel before publication/decision.

provenance.label: [DATA REQUIRED — PAID TOOL]
provenance.meaning: Requires GSC or a licensed keyword/rank/SERP platform; not invented.

provenance.label: [MODELLED]
provenance.meaning: Transparent grouping, formula or operational model.

provenance.label: [STRATEGIC-JUDGEMENT]
provenance.meaning: Strategic recommendation based on the evidence; not a measured ranking claim.
